t: This is 25 Cadogan Gardens, a historic building in Kensington and Chelsea, which is now part of the Peter Jones store. It was designed by Arthur Heygate Mackmurdo, a progressive English architect and designer who influenced the Arts and Crafts movement. In 1882 he set up the Century Guild of Artists in partnership with Herbert Horne. He is regarded as a pioneer of the Modern Style, and through it of the global Art Nouveau movement.
